_comment: Generic defaults only; nothing about any one user belongs here. Per-user values (kit, game, github_owner, harness_remote_url, ue4ss_source) are detected by harness/tools/setup.ps1 and stored outside the repo in %LOCALAPPDATA%/stalker2-modding-harness/settings.json (same keys). harness_remote_url defaults to the github_owner's fork.
